put.description: The slot takes at most as many fixed students as its capacity (DI-66). Generates the student's fixed bookings from today to the end of the rolling window, even on dates that drop-ins filled: the response lists the future lessons of the slot that end up over capacity. If the student had another slot, its scheduled fixed bookings of lessons that have not started are cancelled (ENROLLMENT_CHANGE). Assigning the same slot again only fills the missing dates.
